style: cinematic 3D animation, Pixar-quality chitin shading, matte surfaces, deadpan slapstick
shot: vertical, low angle from the nest entrance, orbital drift all film; shot size pushes in on the padlock and scanner pad from 2.5s, no cuts
character: WASP: burst-start zero to full speed, no wind-up; two-phase stop — body locks, wings jerk once more; double head-jerk overshoot; wings clap out of sync, a stress marker; sharp head-snap turns; same design throughout
cast: BEE CASHIER: heavy monolithic clerk, decides from the torso not a limb, lands full-weight — impact felt, one decisive full-amplitude swing, never small motions; same design throughout
props: hive-computer: branch wax comb blends into one flat screen in a frame, one support only — the branch, no second stand; grid of colored hexagon icons, each with one plain glyph (cloud, bolt, spiral, orbit ring, drop, star), no letters, no logos; metal padlock on a hinge riveted to the frame; flat scanner pad in the bee's thorax; one nectar drop nearby
setting: sunlit meadow at high noon, the branch is the only support in frame
lighting: hard overhead midday sun, crisp highlights, strong contrast, sharp small shadows, no haze

audio.delivery: male, low warm chest voice ~130Hz, dry deadpan, steady, unrushed, native Russian, no accent, @Voice: Sadachbia
audio.pacing: even rate, ~4.3-4.5 syll/sec, two lines in adjoining beats with no gap, both finish with room to spare
audio.lip_sync: mouthparts open and close each syllable, voice comes from the wasp, never a voiceover
audio.pronunciation: «плачу»: stress on second syllable, pla-CHOO not PLA-cha; even pace, no pause before it

timeline.a: No wind-up burst-start, chest slams the screen at full speed, rebounds a body-length, two-phase stop: body locks, wings jerk once more
Double head-jerk overshoot at the padlock; a leg reaches the hinge, recoils on touch, body rocks
Bee drops onto the branch from the next cell, full weight, branch sways; one torso-turn spins the screen to the lens, icon grid flares on
Wasp hits the grid in a hit-bounce-hit series, one leg; each icon blinks out, jerks sideways; after the third hit she grimaces, antennae flatten
Jabs the center icon — the padlock snaps shut over the grid with a clang, knocks her back half a body-length
Bee turns her torso to the lens, padlock and thorax scanner pad fill the frame
timeline.camera: push-in begins, holds to the end

timeline.a: Stinger presses flat, not piercing, to the pad; a spark, two-tone signal, stinger yanks back sharply, body sways
Short freeze, padlock hangs shut, wasp staring at it
On the branch, in one unbroken reach the proboscis crosses frame to a nectar drop, licks it clean, coils back the same path

timeline.line: а я всё равно плачу за доступ к своему улью.
timeline.a: Bee throws her weight onto the key, turns it half a circle, shackle springs open with a click — one event; in one sharp sweep the wings clap shut together, resolving the earlier out-of-sync flapping; mouth only moves for the line
Bee lifts the open padlock off the hinge, hooks it on her abdomen as a trophy with a jingle; the wasp lunges into the screen's gap, snags an instant, wings beat the frame out of sync to tear free
One sharp push, she's inside, the screen slams shut behind her with a thud, a short dust puff; head snaps to the lens, holds, abdomen trembles in tight frequent pulses
